newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 26.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 26.

text.p: These are the main news headlines reported by Radio Latvia at noon on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- The three Baltic president meet in Estonia today to discuss security and economic issues. They will be joined by their Ukrainian and Polish counterparts on Tuesday.
- Following government talks with striking farmers, an agreement has been reached to set up a special working group under the government's auspices.
- Central bank governor Einars Repshe has forecast that inflation in 1997 will not higher than nine percent.

- An opinion poll shows that the Social Democrats are the most popular among the political parties at 14 percent, followed by the Fatherland and Freedom Party and Latvia's Way with 12 and 11 percent respectively.
- Railway restructuring plans will be presented to the cabinet today.
- Janifer Rush presents her new album to a Latvian audience today during a closed performance.
